text: A song; a psalm of Asaph.
I God, do not be silent;God, do not be deaf or remain unmoved! [AA]
See how your enemies rage;your foes proudly raise their heads.
They conspire against your people,plot against those you protect. [AB]
They say, "Come, let us wipe them out as a nation;let Israel's name be remembered no more!"
They scheme with one mind,they have entered into a covenant against you: [AC]
t[1]The tents of Edom and the Ishmaelites,of Moab and the Hagrites, [AD]
Gebal, Ammon, and Amalek, [AE]Philistia and the inhabitants of Tyre. [AF]
Assyria, too, in league with them,backs the descendants of Lot.Selah
II [2]Deal with them as with Midian;as with Sisera and Jabin at the wadi Kishon, [AG]
Those destroyed at Endor,who became dung for the ground. [AH]
Make their nobles like Oreb and Zeeb,all their princes like Zebah and Zalmunna,
Who made a plan together,"Let us take for ourselves the pastures of God."
My God, make them like tumbleweed,into chaff flying before the wind. [AI]
As a fire raging through a forest,a flame setting mountains ablaze, [AJ]
Pursue them with your tempest;terrify them with your storm-wind.
Cover their faces with shame,till they seek your name, [3]Lord.
Let them be ashamed and terrified forever;let them perish in disgrace.
Let them know that your name is Lord,you alone are the Most High over all the earth. [AK]
